title: Strings
definition: A string is a sequence of characters, often represented as an array of characters.
intuition: Strings represent text. In Python, strings are immutable.
how_it_works: Characters are stored sequentially. String operations like concatenation often create new strings.
when_to_use: To represent, parse, or manipulate textual data.
when_not_to_use: When heavy in-place modifications are required (use lists instead).
complexity: Access: O(1), Comparison: O(n), Concatenation: O(n+m)
content: A string is a sequence of characters, often represented as an array of characters.
